matching_contract: Full-frame bbox overlap is a provisional localization candidate, not proof of inserted support. Sampled diagnostics establish exact original-point membership via cluster_source_indices. Components with at least 50% inserted support are distinguished from mixed background components; this is an evaluation attribution rule, not a detector setting.
limits: The ten source-support tracks are forensic reconstructions, not supplied labels. Object order and approximate sizes are checked visually. First exact-provenance sampled detection ranges are lower bounds on earliest detection, not exact all-frame onset. No field recall or hardware-range claim. No tuning of detector configuration.
